title: Tiny, cute candle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- candle body -->
  <rect x='38' y='48' width='24' height='36' rx='5' fill='#f6e7b8'/>
  <!-- candle body shading -->
  <rect x='38' y='48' width='8' height='36' rx='5' fill='#e3d096'/>
  <!-- candle body top rim -->
  <rect x='38' y='46' width='24' height='7' rx='4' fill='#fff6d8'/>
  <!-- wax drips -->
  <path d='M40 55 q-3 8 0 12 q3 -2 2 -12z' fill='#fff6d8'/>
  <path d='M58 52 q4 10 1 15 q-4 -3 -3 -15z' fill='#fff6d8'/>
  <!-- wick -->
  <rect x='48' y='38' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#a86b2e'/>
  <!-- flame outer -->
  <path d='M50 14 q12 12 9 22 q-2 7 -9 7 q-7 0 -9 -7 q-3 -10 9 -22z' fill='#ff9a1f'/>
  <!-- flame inner -->
  <path d='M50 22 q6 8 4 14 q-1 4 -4 4 q-3 0 -4 -4 q-2 -6 4 -14z' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <!-- flame core -->
  <path d='M50 30 q3 5 1 8 q-1 2 -1 2 q0 0 -1 -2 q-2 -3 1 -8z' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <!-- flame glow base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='12' ry='4' fill='#ffd166' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- cute face on candle -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#6b4a1f'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#6b4a1f'/>
  <path d='M46 69 q5 5 9 0' stroke='#6b4a1f' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='68' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#f79a9a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='68' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#f79a9a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- little base / holder -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='18' ry='5' fill='#c98f3d'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='83' rx='18' ry='5' fill='#e0ab55'/>
</svg>
